the psychological adjustment of women recently diagnosed with breast cancer.
the impact of breast cancer on the lives of women, and the role of traumatic stress reactions in this impact.

traumatic stress symptoms are related to a number of demographic, medical, psychosocial and psychological variables among women recently-diagnosed with breast cancer.

traumatic stress symptoms are common in the first 6 months after a diagnosis of primary breast cancer.
